segments.name: Orthopaedics
segments.description: Provides orthopaedic reconstruction implants and trauma and extremities products for hospitals and surgeons.
segments.evidence: Orthopaedics and Sports Medicine & ENT consists of the following businesses: Knee Implants, Hip Implants, Other Reconstruction, Trauma & Extremities, Sports Medicine Joint Repair, Arthroscopic Enabling Technologies and ENT.

segments.name: Sports Medicine & ENT
segments.description: Provides sports medicine joint repair, arthroscopic enabling technologies and ear, nose and throat products for surgeons.
segments.evidence: The Group has concluded that Sports Medicine and ENT meet the aggregation criteria and therefore, these operating segments have been aggregated into a single operating segment.

segments.name: Advanced Wound Management
segments.description: Provides advanced wound care, bioactives and devices products, largely through wholesalers and distributors.
segments.evidence: Advanced Wound Management consists of the following businesses: Advanced Wound Care, Advanced Wound Bioactives and Advanced Wound Devices.

revenueModel.text: The Group sells medical devices to hospitals, Ambulatory Surgery Centers, wholesalers and distributors, recognising revenue when control of the products transfers to the customer.
revenueModel.evidence: In general, our business in Established Markets is direct to hospitals and Ambulatory Surgery Centers, whereas in the Emerging Markets we generally sell through distributors.

changes.text: In 2024, robotics consumables revenue was reclassified from Other Reconstruction to Knee and Hip Implants.
changes.evidence: Robotics consumables revenue has been reclassified from Other Reconstruction to Knee and Hip implants.

changes.text: In 2024, the Group changed its segment trading profit measure by allocating directly attributable corporate costs to business units.
changes.evidence: In 2024, the Group changed the segment trading profit measure presented to the ExCo by allocating directly attributable corporate costs to business units.

changes.text: In 2023, management concluded that Engage products should be discontinued and wrote off their assets and liabilities.
changes.evidence: During 2023, management evaluated the commercial viability of Engage products and concluded that they should be discontinued.
